Guidance for AI coding agents (such as OpenAI Codex) in this React + Vite + Tailwind CSS repository. Maintain a clean, authentic ML portfolio for a BCA student; avoid exaggerated claims or fake expertise.

UI: flashy marketing style; exaggerated personal branding; modern developer portfolios or AI dashboards. Accents `#38BDF8`, `#22D3EE`; headings Space Grotesk; H1 main page headlines. Homepage sections order: machine learning projects; each section grid layout content. Use reusable, modular, readable React components and clean folder structure. Avoid overly complex code and unnecessary dependencies.

Project card: Titanic Survival Prediction; Dataset: Kaggle Titanic Dataset; Model: Logistic Regression; Tools: Python, Pandas, Scikit-Learn. Project pages: fade-in section reveal; Avoid heavy animations or distracting motion.

Use icons for navigation, skills, and project cards. Ensure mobile-first design: responsive grid layouts, readable text on mobile, large touch buttons, lazy loading images.

Content must remain authentic. Do NOT claim:
professional experience not actually achieved
research credentials not earned

If technically feasible, AI agents may implement:
"Try the Model" interactive section
Titanic survival prediction input form.
If implementation becomes complex, skip this feature.

Changes are complete when UI is clean and modern, ML projects are clearly presented, portfolio feels authentic, mobile layout works well, and performance remains fast.
